description: Searches the mailbox that receives bounces for delivery reports about one sent message. Uses IMAP EXAMINE and BODY.PEEK, so it does not change the mailbox or mark mail as read.

connection.name: bounce_mailbox
connection.description: IMAP mailbox that receives delivery reports for the sending address, as imaps://USER@HOST:993/INBOX. Used only to read.

needs: A runtime profile mail_observer whose env lists MAIL_OBSERVER_PASSWORD (an app password for the bounce mailbox), and the bounce_mailbox connection URL in runtime.json.

inputs.description: The recipient address of the sent message, for example inputs.ap_lead.

effect.intent: The recipient's mail server accepts the message and does not return it.

setup: In runtime.json, add runtimes.mail_observer = {"command": "node", "version": "22", "env": ["MAIL_OBSERVER_PASSWORD"]} and environment.bounce_mailbox = "imaps://USER@HOST:993/INBOX". Set MAIL_OBSERVER_PASSWORD wherever method run and method observe run. Use an app password with read access only where the provider allows it. The send step must put METHOD_OPERATION_ID in the message, for example Message-ID: <TOKEN@your-domain>; without it the observer can match bounces only by recipient address. Schedule method observe --pending, for example hourly, so bounces that arrive after the run reach it.
